Wildlife and Resident Finfish Narrative (Section III.A.2.c)Estuarine Habitat (EST); Marine Habitat (MAR); Preservation of Rare, Threatened &Endangered Species (RARE); Preservation of Biological Habitats of Special Concern (ASBS); Wildlife Habitat (WILD), Spawning Reproduction and Early Development (SPWN).Pollutants shall not be present in sediment at levels that alone or in combination are toxic to wildlife and resident finfish by direct exposure or bioaccumulate in aquatic life at levels that are harmful to wildlife or resident finfish by indirect exposure in bays and estuaries of California. This narrative objective shall be implemented as described in Chapter IV.A.3.
